version.changelog: Upgraded to v1.1.0: added Quick Reference table, 7-step workflow, 2 worked examples, 10 common mistakes, and reference files.

llm.summary: This is a markdown-only ecommerce seller account audit guide with no executable behavior or hidden agent instructions.

dimensions.detail: The workflow involves sensitive seller-account and business data, including financial holds and customer feedback, but access is manual, disclosed, and proportionate to an account audit.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown files only, with no scripts, dependencies, remote code retrieval, or executable install behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are framed as user-directed audit steps and templates; I found no role changes, prompt overrides, safety suppression, or hidden behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, credential storage, background workers, privilege escalation, or memory-writing behavior appears in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's guidance for reviewing account health, listings, policy notices, customer feedback, financial holds, and inventory fits its stated Seller Audit purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that the skill will guide you through reviewing seller dashboards and business-sensitive account data. Use it with accounts you are authorized to audit and avoid pasting credentials or unnecessary private customer data into the agent.
llm.findings: [AR2] expected: The scanner matched the phrase "without warning" in a sentence about platform policy changes; this is ordinary audit guidance, not an instruction to suppress warnings or bypass refusals.
